clue.text: Adjustment by quarters, perhaps

definitions.meaning: an adjustment or settlement reached between two sides is an ...
lodgings or living quarters are ..., the 'perhaps' marking quarters as one example

explanation.surface: A tweak made in fourths, possibly.
explanation.definitionFit: Both senses hold: a compromise reached between parties, and a place to stay such as quarters.

clue.text: Girl is able to go out in a boat

indicators.note: the word for 'is able' goes out, around the outside of the girl's name

explanation.surface: A young woman is allowed to go sailing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'is able to go out' reads as permission to leave; in fact the word for 'is able' goes round the girl, and 'in' joins wordplay to the boat.
explanation.definitionFit: A twin-hulled sailing vessel is a kind of boat.

clue.text: Iris is something of a poor risk

indicators.note: something of says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A flower is said to be a bad gamble.
explanation.walkthrough: 'something of' hides the run inside 'poor risk'.
explanation.definitionFit: Orris is a species of iris, prized for its fragrant root used in perfume.

clue.text: Note: come round anyhow for a drink

indicators.note: turned round in any old way, so these letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: Someone is invited to come over casually for a glass of something.
explanation.definitionFit: Medoc is a red Bordeaux wine, so a drink.

clue.text: Use magic dots for study of theology

indicators.note: make use of these letters, putting them to work in a fresh order

explanation.surface: Applying magic dots as a method of studying religion.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Use' is the anagram signal on MAGIC DOTS.
explanation.definitionFit: Dogmatics is the branch of theology dealing with the systematic statement of doctrine.

clue.text: Cuts off valves

definitions.meaning: strangles or cuts off a supply
valves controlling the flow of fuel to an engine

explanation.surface: Shuts off some valves.
explanation.definitionFit: A throttle chokes or stops something, and a throttle is also an engine's fuel-control valve.

clue.text: Took a picture of part of an animal with horns

indicators.note: part of says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Someone photographed only a portion of a horned beast.
explanation.walkthrough: 'part of' hides the run inside 'Took a picture'; 'of' joins it to the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: The okapi, a giraffe relative, bears short skin-covered horns.

clue.text: Falling in great haste

definitions.meaning: rain, snow or hail falling from the sky

explanation.surface: Tumbling over in a terrible hurry.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both rain or snow that falls and sudden, reckless hurry.

clue.text: Resolution to the end

definitions.meaning: a legal sense: the ending or termination of something, such as a lease

explanation.surface: A firm resolve to see things through.
explanation.definitionFit: It means steadfast resolve, and in law the termination of an estate or contract.

clue.text: Shy and withdrawn

definitions.meaning: having left work or gone back, as from a battle or post

explanation.surface: Bashful and keeping to oneself.
explanation.definitionFit: Both words carry the sense: a retiring person is shy, and someone retired has withdrawn from work.

clue.text: Refuse to give much time to dress

parts.note: an age is a long time

explanation.surface: Declining to spend ages on getting dressed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Refuse' looks like a verb but is the noun, rubbish.
explanation.definitionFit: Garbage is rubbish, refuse in the noun sense.

clue.text: He wrote about a tree

indicators.note: turned about, so the tree's name reads backwards

parts.note: the sumac is a tree or shrub

explanation.surface: An author's work on a single tree.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' looks like 'on the subject of' but turns SUMAC round.
explanation.definitionFit: Albert Camus was a French author of The Outsider, a man who wrote.

clue.text: Alec is not swimming in the sea here

indicators.note: these letters swim about into a new order

explanation.surface: Alec is staying out of the water today.
explanation.definitionFit: The shore where land meets the water is the place you find the sea.

clue.text: Standard is found in France

parts.note: par is the standard or normal level

explanation.surface: A normal level is located in France.
explanation.definitionFit: Paris is the capital city, a place located in France.

clue.text: Leading contenders for a place in drink catalogue

parts.note: a short is a small measure of spirits

explanation.surface: The top candidates for a post are listed in a drinks menu.
explanation.definitionFit: A shortlist is the final group of candidates chosen from applicants for a job.

clue.text: Can more be stored in the pantry?

definitions.meaning: a room in a large house where preserves and drinks are kept

explanation.surface: Asking whether the larder has any space left.
explanation.definitionFit: A stillroom was a household storeroom for preserves and cordials, and 'still room' answers whether more fits.

clue.text: Without feeling silly …

explanation.surface: Numb and foolish at once.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both unconscious and foolish or pointless.

clue.text: … give too much to unwanted children

parts.note: over in the sense of left over, surplus to need

explanation.surface: Lavishing too much on children nobody wanted.
explanation.definitionFit: To overissue is to put out more of something, such as shares or notes, than is allowed.

clue.text: What boxer might do with a lot of bread

definitions.meaning: go the distance of a fight in a number of rounds
rounds are slices or sandwiches of bread, so ten of them is plenty

explanation.surface: A fighter's activity involving lots of loaves.
explanation.definitionFit: A boxer may last ten rounds, and ten rounds of bread are a heap of slices.

clue.text: Point to bird's rump

parts.note: S is the south point of the compass

explanation.surface: Pointing at a bird's backside.
explanation.definitionFit: The stern is the rear of a ship, and colloquially the hindquarters or rump.

clue.text: Just what the doctor ordered?

parts.note: the phrase usually means something ideal, but read literally it is the care a doctor prescribes

explanation.surface: Something that is exactly right.
explanation.definitionFit: Medical care is what a doctor prescribes for a patient.

clue.text: Sign up for first half of venture

indicators.note: only the opening half of the word for a venture is kept

explanation.surface: Joining up for the start of a project.
explanation.definitionFit: To enter a race or contest is to sign up for it.

clue.text: He will take anything, if given the combination

indicators.note: these letters are combined in a new order, like a safe's combination

explanation.surface: A burglar takes whatever he can if he knows the safe's code.
explanation.walkthrough: 'combination' suggests a safe's code but signals the anagram of IF THE.
explanation.definitionFit: A thief is someone who steals, taking whatever he can.

clue.text: Deal dishonestly in tobacco

explanation.surface: Cheating in the tobacco trade.
explanation.definitionFit: To twist is to cheat someone, and twist is tobacco rolled into a rope.

clue.text: He takes a drop to postpone early retirement initially

indicators.note: the first letters of the following words are taken

explanation.surface: A man has a drink to put off retiring early.
explanation.definitionFit: A toper is a heavy drinker, one who takes a drop.

clue.text: Unfashionable team in the Open

explanation.surface: An unpopular team at the golf championship.
explanation.walkthrough: 'the Open' looks like the golf tournament; it is the open air.
explanation.definitionFit: Being outdoors is being in the open air.

clue.text: Show naughty child when to paint

parts.note: an imp is a mischievous child

explanation.surface: Teach a mischievous youngster when it is time to paint.
explanation.definitionFit: Impasto is paint laid on thickly so brushstrokes stand out.

clue.text: Scribes hit for misrepresentation of our boys and girls

indicators.note: these words are misrepresented, set out in a garbled order

explanation.surface: Writers attacked for a false portrayal of our servicemen and women.
explanation.definitionFit: The armed services of the UK, its soldiers, sailors and airmen, are affectionately our boys and girls.
